newsitem.title: CANADA: AGF plans C$50 mln debenture redemption.
newsitem.headline: AGF plans C$50 mln debenture redemption.

text.p: AGF Management Ltd announced on Wednesday that it intends to redeem all C$50 million worth of its 6.75 percent convertible unsecured subordinated debentures due November 30, 2008.
The debentures may be converted or redeemed at any time on or before January 8, 1997 at a conversion price of C$21 per class B non-voting share, the company said.
Holders of the debentures will be entitled to receive accrued and unpaid interest up to the date of conversion, AGF said.
The company also said it would meet its obligation to pay the aggregate redemption price on any debentures not redeemed by January 8, 1997.
